name: episodic-shift-train-s44
description: Train persistent-memory head on shift-by-k cached Qwen episodes (carry vs reset uses identical weights)
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish
V=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
MODEL=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/qz/grouped_bce_4gpu_s44/v1/final
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
mkdir -p "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz"
cd "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish"
test -f "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_shift_v5/train.pt" && test -f "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_shift_v5/dev.pt" || { echo "cache missing; run episodic-shift-cache first"; exit 3; }
"$V/bin/python" harness/train_episodic_features.py --train-cache "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_shift_v5/train.pt" --dev-cache "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_shift_v5/dev.pt" --output "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_shift_qwen_v5_s44" --device cuda --seed 44 --epochs 5 --inner-steps 4 --latent-dim 128 --rule-weight 1.0 > "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz/episodic_shift_train_s44.log" 2>&1
status=$?; echo "JOB EXIT=$status"; exit $status
